features: Month, week, day and agenda views with a locale-aware header
Click or drag to create events; six preset colours, notes and simple recurrence
Event reminders with panel, email and sound notifications, presets or a custom offset
ICS import and export — no network, works with any calendar app
Full keyboard control: arrows, T for today, N for new event, 1-4 to switch views
Upcoming shelf widget: today's date, a 7-day strip and your next events
requirements: A Tend panel running schema-2 (native ESM) extensions
A desktop or mobile browser tab with ES module support
release_notes: 1.5.0: Start and End are now one bar split into two equal halves — date on the left, time on the right — instead of a full-width date row; below about 420px the halves stack, date above time. While All day is checked, the time half is hidden outright and the date half takes the full bar, replacing 1.4.0's dimmed-but-visible treatment.
